verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא רָחֵ֗ל כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָֽלְדָה֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וַתְּקַנֵּ֥א רָחֵ֖ל בַּאֲחֹתָ֑הּ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹב֙ הָֽבָה־ לִּ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְאִם־ אַ֖יִן מֵתָ֥ה אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re rā·ḥêl kî lō yā·lə·ḏāh lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wat·tə·qan·nê rā·ḥêl ba·’ă·ḥō·ṯāh wat·tō·mer ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ hā·ḇāh- lî ḇā·nîm wə·’im- ’a·yin mê·ṯāh ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing any children for Jacob she envied her sister Give me children or . . . I will die she said to Jacob
verses.literalPt: VENDO Raquel que não dava filhos a Jacó, teve inveja de sua irmã, e disse a Jacó: Dá-me filhos, se não morro.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּרָחֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲתַ֤חַת אֱלֹהִים֙ אָנֹ֔כִי אֲשֶׁר־ מָנַ֥ע מִמֵּ֖ךְ פְּרִי־ בָֽטֶן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·rā·ḥêl way·yō·mer hă·ṯa·ḥaṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·šer- mā·na‘ mim·mêḵ pə·rî- ḇā·ṭen
verses.literal: Jacob became angry . . . with Rachel and said Am I in the place of God who has withheld children . . . from you
verses.literalPt: Então se acendeu a ira de Jacó contra Raquel, e disse: Estou eu no lugar de Deus, que te impediu o fruto de teu ventre?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה אֲמָתִ֥י בִלְהָ֖ה בֹּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יהָ וְתֵלֵד֙ עַל־ בִּרְכַּ֔י וְאִבָּנֶ֥ה גַם־ אָנֹכִ֖י מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hin·nêh ’ă·mā·ṯî ḇil·hāh bō ’ê·le·hā wə·ṯê·lêḏ ‘al- bir·kay wə·’ib·bā·neh ḡam- ’ā·nō·ḵî mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Then she said Here is my maidservant Bilhah Sleep with her that she may bear children for me so that through her I too can build a family
verses.literalPt: E ela disse: Eis aqui minha serva Bila; coabita com ela, para que dê à luz sobre meus joelhos, e eu assim receba filhos por ela.

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ בִּלְהָ֥ה שִׁפְחָתָ֖הּ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·ten- lōw ’eṯ- bil·hāh šip̄·ḥā·ṯāh lə·’iš·šāh way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: So Rachel gave Jacob her servant Bilhah as a wife and he slept with her
verses.literalPt: Assim lhe deu a Bila, sua serva, por mulher; e Jacó a possuiu.

verses.original: וַתַּ֣הַר בִּלְהָ֔ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har bil·hāh wat·tê·leḏ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bên
verses.literal: and Bilhah conceived and bore him a son
verses.literalPt: E concebeu Bila, e deu a Jacó um filho.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר רָחֵל֙ דָּנַ֣נִּי אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְגַם֙ שָׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלִ֔י וַיִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י בֵּ֑ן עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרְאָ֥ה שְׁמ֖וֹ דָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer rā·ḥêl dā·nan·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḡam šā·ma‘ bə·qō·lî way·yit·ten- lî bên ‘al- kên qā·rə·’āh šə·mōw dān
verses.literal: Then Rachel said God has vindicated me He has heard my plea and given me a son . . . . . . So she named him . . . Dan
verses.literalPt: Então disse Raquel: Julgou-me Deus, e também ouviu a minha voz, e me deu um filho; por isso chamou-lhe Dã.

verses.original: וַתַּ֣הַר ע֔וֹד וַתֵּ֕לֶד בִּלְהָ֖ה שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֑ל בֵּ֥ן שֵׁנִ֖י לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ wat·tê·leḏ bil·hāh šip̄·ḥaṯ rā·ḥêl bên šê·nî lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: And Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son
verses.literalPt: E Bila, serva de Raquel, concebeu outra vez, e deu a Jacó o segundo filho.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר רָחֵ֗ל נַפְתּוּלֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ נִפְתַּ֛לְתִּי עִם־ אֲחֹתִ֖י גַּם־ יָכֹ֑לְתִּי וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer rā·ḥêl nap̄·tū·lê ’ĕ·lō·hîm nip̄·tal·tî ‘im- ’ă·ḥō·ṯî gam- yā·ḵō·lə·tî wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: Then Rachel said In my great struggles . . . I have wrestled with my sister and won So she named him Naphtali
verses.literalPt: Então disse Raquel: Com grandes lutas tenho lutado com minha irmã; também venci; e chamou-lhe Naftali.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא לֵאָ֔ה כִּ֥י עָמְדָ֖ה מִלֶּ֑דֶת וַתִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ זִלְפָּ֣ה שִׁפְחָתָ֔הּ וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛הּ לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re lê·’āh kî ‘ā·mə·ḏāh mil·le·ḏeṯ wat·tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- zil·pāh šip̄·ḥā·ṯāh wat·tit·tên ’ō·ṯāh lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children she gave - her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, Lia que cessava de ter filhos, tomou também a Zilpa, sua serva, e deu-a a Jacó por mulher.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶד זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה לְיַעֲקֹ֥ב בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ zil·pāh šip̄·ḥaṯ lê·’āh lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bên
verses.literal: And Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son
verses.literalPt: E deu Zilpa, serva de Lia, um filho a Jacó.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לֵאָ֖ה בְּגָד וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ גָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lê·’āh bə·ḡå̄ḏ wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw gāḏ
verses.literal: Then Leah said How fortunate So she named him Gad
verses.literalPt: Então disse Lia: Afortunada! e chamou-lhe Gade.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶד זִלְפָּה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת לֵאָ֔ה בֵּ֥ן שֵׁנִ֖י לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ zil·pāh šip̄·ḥaṯ lê·’āh bên šê·nî lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: When Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son
verses.literalPt: Depois deu Zilpa, serva de Lia, um segundo filho a Jacó.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֔ה בְּאָשְׁרִ֕י כִּ֥י אִשְּׁר֖וּנִי בָּנ֑וֹת וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אָשֵֽׁר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lê·’āh bə·’ā·šə·rî kî ’iš·šə·rū·nî bā·nō·wṯ wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ā·šêr
verses.literal: Leah said How happy I am For the women call me happy So she named him Asher
verses.literalPt: Então disse Lia: Para minha ventura; porque as filhas me terão por bem-aventurada; e chamou-lhe Aser.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֜ן בִּימֵ֣י קְצִיר־ חִטִּ֗ים וַיִּמְצָ֤א דֽוּדָאִים֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתָ֔ם אֶל־ לֵאָ֖ה אִמּ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר רָחֵל֙ אֶל־ לֵאָ֔ה תְּנִי־ נָ֣א לִ֔י מִדּוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ rə·’ū·ḇên bî·mê qə·ṣîr- ḥiṭ·ṭîm way·yim·ṣā ḏū·ḏā·’îm baś·śā·ḏeh way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯām ’el- lê·’āh ’im·mōw wat·tō·mer rā·ḥêl ’el- lê·’āh tə·nî- nā lî mid·dū·ḏā·’ê bə·nêḵ
verses.literal: Now during the wheat harvest Reuben . . . went out and found some mandrakes in the field When he brought them to his mother Rachel begged . . . Leah Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes
verses.literalPt: E foi Rúben nos dias da ceifa do trigo, e achou mandrágoras no campo. E trouxe-as a Lia sua mãe. Então disse Raquel a Lia: Ora dá-me das mandrágoras de teu filho.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֗הּ הַמְעַט֙ קַחְתֵּ֣ךְ אֶת־ אִישִׁ֔י וְלָקַ֕חַת גַּ֥ם אֶת־ דּוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנִ֑י וַתֹּ֣אמֶר רָחֵ֗ל לָכֵן֙ יִשְׁכַּ֤ב עִמָּךְ֙ הַלַּ֔יְלָה תַּ֖חַת דּוּדָאֵ֥י בְנֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lāh ham·‘aṭ qaḥ·têḵ ’eṯ- ’î·šî wə·lā·qa·ḥaṯ gam ’eṯ- dū·ḏā·’ê bə·nî wat·tō·mer rā·ḥêl lā·ḵên yiš·kaḇ ‘im·māḵ hal·lay·lāh ta·ḥaṯ dū·ḏā·’ê ḇə·nêḵ
verses.literal: But Leah replied Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well Very well said Rachel he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes
verses.literalPt: E ela lhe disse: É já pouco que hajas tomado o meu marido, tomarás também as mandrágoras do meu filho? Então disse Raquel: Por isso ele se deitará contigo esta noite pelas mandrágoras de teu filho.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֣ב מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶה֮ בָּעֶרֶב֒ וַתֵּצֵ֨א לֵאָ֜ה לִקְרָאת֗וֹ וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵלַ֣י תָּב֔וֹא כִּ֚י שָׂכֹ֣ר שְׂכַרְתִּ֔יךָ בְּדוּדָאֵ֖י בְּנִ֑י וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עִמָּ֖הּ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ya·‘ă·qōḇ min- haś·śā·ḏeh bā·‘e·reḇ wat·tê·ṣê lê·’āh liq·rā·ṯōw wat·tō·mer ’ê·lay tā·ḇō·w kî śā·ḵōr śə·ḵar·tî·ḵā bə·ḏū·ḏā·’ê bə·nî way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im·māh bal·lay·lāh hū
verses.literal: When Jacob came in from the field that evening Leah went out to meet him and said You must come with me for I have hired you . . . with my son’s mandrakes So he slept with her that night
verses.literalPt: Vindo, pois, Jacó à tarde do campo, saiu-lhe Lia ao encontro, e disse: A mim possuirás, esta noite, porque certamente te aluguei com as mandrágoras do meu filho. E deitou-se com ela aquela noite.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ לֵאָ֑ה וַתַּ֛הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בֵּ֥ן חֲמִישִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- lê·’āh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bên ḥă·mî·šî
verses.literal: And God listened to Leah and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob
verses.literalPt: E ouviu Deus a Lia, e concebeu, e deu à luz um quinto filho.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן אֱלֹהִים֙ שְׂכָרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי שִׁפְחָתִ֖י לְאִישִׁ֑י וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשָּׂשכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lê·’āh nā·ṯan ’ĕ·lō·hîm śə·ḵā·rî ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî šip̄·ḥā·ṯî lə·’î·šî wat·tiq·rā šə·mōw yiś·śā·š·ḵār
verses.literal: Then Leah said God has rewarded me . . . for giving my maidservant to my husband So she named him . . . Issachar
verses.literalPt: Então disse Lia: Deus me tem dado o meu galardão, pois tenho dado minha serva ao meu marido. E chamou-lhe Issacar.

verses.original: וַתַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ לֵאָ֔ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֖י לְּיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har ‘ō·wḏ lê·’āh wat·tê·leḏ bên- šiš·šî lə·ya·ʿă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Again Leah conceived and bore a sixth son to Jacob
verses.literalPt: E Lia concebeu outra vez, e deu a Jacó um sexto filho.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאָ֗ה זְבָדַ֨נִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ אֹתִי֮ זֵ֣בֶד טוֹב֒ הַפַּ֙עַם֙ יִזְבְּלֵ֣נִי אִישִׁ֔י כִּֽי־ יָלַ֥דְתִּי ל֖וֹ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ זְבֻלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lê·’āh zə·ḇā·ḏa·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·ṯî zê·ḇeḏ ṭō·wḇ hap·pa·‘am yiz·bə·lê·nî ’î·šî kî- yā·laḏ·tî lōw šiš·šāh ḇā·nîm wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw zə·ḇu·lūn
verses.literal: God has given me a good gift she said This time my husband will honor me because I have borne him six sons And she named him Zebulun
verses.literalPt: E disse Lia: Deus me deu uma boa dádiva; desta vez morará o meu marido comigo, porque lhe tenho dado seis filhos. E chamou-lhe Zebulom.

verses.original: וְאַחַ֖ר יָ֣לְדָה בַּ֑ת וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמָ֖הּ דִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥar yā·lə·ḏāh baṯ wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·māh dî·nāh
verses.literal: After that Leah gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah
verses.literalPt: E depois teve uma filha, e chamou-lhe Diná.

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ רָחֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־ רַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- rā·ḥêl way·yiš·ma‘ ’ê·le·hā ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- raḥ·māh
verses.literal: Then God remembered Rachel He listened to her and opened her womb
verses.literalPt: E lembrou-se Deus de Raquel; e Deus a ouviu, e abriu a sua madre.

verses.original: וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר אָסַ֥ף אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ חֶרְפָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tō·mer ’ā·sap̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ḥer·pā·ṯî
verses.literal: and she conceived and gave birth to a son God has taken away my shame she said
verses.literalPt: E ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Tirou-me Deus a minha vergonha.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֧א אֶת־ שְׁמ֛וֹ יוֹסֵ֖ף לֵאמֹ֑ר יֹסֵ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י בֵּ֥ן אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw yō·w·sêp̄ lê·mōr yō·sêp̄ Yah·weh lî bên ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: She named him Joseph and said May the LORD add to me another son
verses.literalPt: E chamou-lhe José, dizendo: O SENHOR me acrescente outro filho.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָלְדָ֥ה רָחֵ֖ל אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־ לָבָ֔ן שַׁלְּחֵ֙נִי֙ וְאֵ֣לְכָ֔ה אֶל־ מְקוֹמִ֖י וּלְאַרְצִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh rā·ḥêl ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- lā·ḇān šal·lə·ḥê·nî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh ’el- mə·qō·w·mî ū·lə·’ar·ṣî
verses.literal: Now after Rachel had given birth to Joseph Jacob said to Laban Send me on my way so I can return to my homeland . . .
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, como Raquel deu à luz a José, disse Jacó a Labão: Deixa-me ir, que me vá ao meu lugar, e à minha terra.

verses.original: תְּנָ֞ה אֶת־ נָשַׁ֣י וְאֶת־ יְלָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֧דְתִּי אֹֽתְךָ֛ בָּהֵ֖ן וְאֵלֵ֑כָה כִּ֚י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֶת־ עֲבֹדָתִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲבַדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nāh ’eṯ- nā·šay wə·’eṯ- yə·lā·ḏay ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇaḏ·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā bā·hên wə·’ê·lê·ḵāh kî ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯî ’ă·šer ‘ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: Give me my wives and children for whom I have served you - that I may go on my way . . . You know how hard I have worked for you
verses.literalPt: Dá-me as minhas mulheres, e os meus filhos, pelas quais te tenho servido, e ir-me-ei; pois tu sabes o serviço que te tenho feito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ לָבָ֔ן אִם־ נָ֛א מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ נִחַ֕שְׁתִּי וַיְבָרֲכֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה בִּגְלָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lā·ḇān ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ni·ḥaš·tî way·ḇā·ră·ḵê·nî Yah·weh biḡ·lā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: But Laban replied . . . If I have found favor in your eyes please stay I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse Labão: Se agora tenho achado graça em teus olhos, fica comigo. Tenho experimentado que o SENHOR me abençoou por amor de ti.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נָקְבָ֧ה שְׂכָרְךָ֛ עָלַ֖י וְאֶתֵּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar nā·qə·ḇāh śə·ḵā·rə·ḵā ‘ā·lay wə·’et·tê·nāh
verses.literal: And he added Name your wages . . . and I will pay them
verses.literalPt: E disse mais: Determina-me o teu salário, que to darei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲבַדְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה מִקְנְךָ֖ אִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’êṯ ’ă·šer ‘ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā wə·’êṯ ’ă·šer- hā·yāh miq·nə·ḵā ’it·tî
verses.literal: Then Jacob answered . . . You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse: Tu sabes como te tenho servido, e como passou o teu gado comigo.

verses.original: כִּ֡י מְעַט֩ אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֨ה לְךָ֤ לְפָנַי֙ וַיִּפְרֹ֣ץ לָרֹ֔ב וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֹתְךָ֖ לְרַגְלִ֑י וְעַתָּ֗ה מָתַ֛י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה גַם־ אָנֹכִ֖י לְבֵיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·‘aṭ ’ă·šer- hā·yāh lə·ḵā lə·p̄ā·nay way·yip̄·rōṣ lā·rōḇ way·ḇā·reḵ Yah·weh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā lə·raḡ·lî wə·‘at·tāh mā·ṯay ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḡam- ’ā·nō·ḵî lə·ḇê·ṯî
verses.literal: Indeed you had . . . very little before my arrival but now your wealth has increased many times over The LORD has blessed you wherever I set foot But now when may I also provide for my own household
verses.literalPt: Porque o pouco que tinhas antes de mim tem aumentado em grande número; e o SENHOR te tem abençoado por meu trabalho. Agora, pois, quando hei de trabalhar também por minha casa?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מָ֣ה אֶתֶּן־ לָ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לֹא־ תִתֶּן־ לִ֣י מְא֔וּמָה אִם־ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לִּי֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה אָשׁ֛וּבָה אֶרְעֶ֥ה צֹֽאנְךָ֖ אֶשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh ’et·ten- lāḵ way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ lō- ṯit·ten- lî mə·’ū·māh ’im- ta·‘ă·śeh- lî had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ā·šū·ḇāh ’er·‘eh ṣō·nə·ḵā ’eš·mōr
verses.literal: What can I give you Laban asked You do not need to give me anything Jacob replied . . . If you do this one thing for me I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Que te darei? Então disse Jacó: Nada me darás. Se me fizeres isto, tornarei a apascentar e a guardar o teu rebanho;

verses.original: אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בְּכָל־ צֹֽאנְךָ֜ הַיּ֗וֹם הָסֵ֨ר מִשָּׁ֜ם כָּל־ שֶׂ֣ה׀ נָקֹ֣ד וְטָל֗וּא וְכָל־ שֶׂה־ חוּם֙ בַּכְּשָׂבִ֔ים וְטָל֥וּא וְנָקֹ֖ד בָּעִזִּ֑ים וְהָיָ֖ה שְׂכָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·‘ĕ·ḇōr bə·ḵāl ṣō·nə·ḵā hay·yō·wm hā·sêr miš·šām kāl- śeh nā·qōḏ wə·ṭā·lū wə·ḵāl śeh- ḥūm bak·kə·śā·ḇîm wə·ṭā·lū wə·nā·qōḏ bā·‘iz·zîm wə·hā·yāh śə·ḵā·rî
verses.literal: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat These will be my wages
verses.literalPt: Passarei hoje por todo o teu rebanho, separando dele todos os salpicados e malhados, e todos os morenos entre os cordeiros, e os malhados e salpicados entre as cabras; e isto será o meu salário.

verses.original: וְעָֽנְתָה־ בִּ֤י צִדְקָתִי֙ בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֔ר כִּֽי־ תָב֥וֹא עַל־ שְׂכָרִ֖י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֵינֶנּוּ֩ נָקֹ֨ד וְטָל֜וּא בָּֽעִזִּ֗ים וְחוּם֙ בַּכְּשָׂבִ֔ים גָּנ֥וּב ה֖וּא אִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nə·ṯāh- bî ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî bə·yō·wm mā·ḥār kî- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘al- śə·ḵā·rî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā kōl ’ă·šer- ’ê·nen·nū nā·qōḏ wə·ṭā·lū bā·‘iz·zîm wə·ḥūm bak·kə·śā·ḇîm gā·nūḇ hū ’it·tî
verses.literal: So my honesty will testify for me when you come to check . . . on my wages in the future . . . If I have any goats that are not speckled or spotted or any lambs that are not dark-colored they will be considered stolen
verses.literalPt: Assim testificará por mim a minha justiça no dia de amanhã, quando vieres e o meu salário estiver diante de tua face; tudo o que não for salpicado e malhado entre as cabras e moreno entre os cordeiros, ser-me-á por furto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָבָ֖ן הֵ֑ן ל֖וּ יְהִ֥י כִדְבָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·ḇān hên lū yə·hî ḵiḏ·ḇā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Agreed . . . said Laban Let it be as you have said
verses.literalPt: Então disse Labão: Quem dera seja conforme a tua palavra.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣סַר בַּיּוֹם֩ הַה֨וּא אֶת־ הַתְּיָשִׁ֜ים הָֽעֲקֻדִּ֣ים וְהַטְּלֻאִ֗ים וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הָֽעִזִּים֙ הַנְּקֻדּ֣וֹת וְהַטְּלֻאֹ֔ת כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ לָבָן֙ בּ֔וֹ וְכָל־ ח֖וּם בַּכְּשָׂבִ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֖ן בְּיַד־ בָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’eṯ- hat·tə·yā·šîm hā·‘ă·qud·dîm wə·haṭ·ṭə·lu·’îm wə·’êṯ kāl- hā·‘iz·zîm han·nə·qud·dō·wṯ wə·haṭ·ṭə·lu·’ōṯ kōl ’ă·šer- lā·ḇān bōw wə·ḵāl ḥūm bak·kə·śā·ḇîm way·yit·tên bə·yaḏ- bā·nāw
verses.literal: That very day Laban removed all the streaked or spotted male goats and every speckled or spotted female goat every one that had any white on it and every dark-colored lamb and he placed them under the care of his sons
verses.literalPt: E separou naquele mesmo dia os bodes listrados e malhados e todas as cabras salpicadas e malhadas, todos em que havia brancura, e todos os morenos entre os cordeiros; e deu-os nas mãos dos seus filhos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֗שֶׂם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים בֵּינ֖וֹ וּבֵ֣ין יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיַעֲקֹ֗ב רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת־ צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן הַנּוֹתָרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm bê·nōw ū·ḇên ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ rō·‘eh ’eṯ- ṣōn lā·ḇān han·nō·w·ṯā·rōṯ
verses.literal: Then he put a three-day . . . journey between himself . . . and Jacob while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks
verses.literalPt: E pôs três dias de caminho entre si e Jacó; e Jacó apascentava o restante dos rebanhos de Labão.

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֣וֹ יַעֲקֹ֗ב מַקַּ֥ל לִבְנֶ֛ה לַ֖ח וְל֣וּז וְעֶרְמ֑וֹן וַיְפַצֵּ֤ל בָּהֵן֙ פְּצָל֣וֹת לְבָנ֔וֹת מַחְשֹׂף֙ הַלָּבָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמַּקְלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ maq·qal liḇ·neh laḥ wə·lūz wə·ʿɛr·mōn way·p̄aṣ·ṣêl bā·hên pə·ṣā·lō·wṯ lə·ḇā·nō·wṯ maḥ·śōp̄ hal·lā·ḇān ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·maq·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Jacob, however took . . . fresh branches of poplar almond and plane trees and peeled the bark exposing . . . the white inner wood of the branches
verses.literalPt: Então tomou Jacó varas verdes de álamo e de aveleira e de castanheiro, e descascou nelas riscas brancas, descobrindo a brancura que nas varas havia,

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֗ג אֶת־ הַמַּקְלוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּצֵּ֔ל בָּרֳהָטִ֖ים בְּשִֽׁקֲת֣וֹת הַמָּ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨אןָ הַצֹּ֤אן לִשְׁתּוֹת֙ לְנֹ֣כַח הַצֹּ֔אן וַיֵּחַ֖מְנָה בְּבֹאָ֥ן לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·ṣêḡ ’eṯ- ham·maq·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer piṣ·ṣêl bā·ro·hā·ṭîm bə·ši·qă·ṯō·wṯ ham·mā·yim ’ă·šer tā·ḇō·nā haṣ·ṣōn liš·tō·wṯ lə·nō·ḵaḥ haṣ·ṣōn way·yê·ḥam·nāh bə·ḇō·’ān liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then he set the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of the flocks coming in to drink So when the flocks were in heat and came to drink
verses.literalPt: E pôs estas varas, que tinha descascado, em frente aos rebanhos, nos canos e nos bebedouros de água, aonde os rebanhos vinham beber, para que concebessem quando vinham beber.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱמ֥וּ הַצֹּ֖אן אֶל־ הַמַּקְל֑וֹת וַתֵּלַ֣דְןָ הַצֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּטְלֻאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·mū haṣ·ṣōn ’el- ham·maq·lō·wṯ wat·tê·laḏ·nā haṣ·ṣōn ‘ă·qud·dîm nə·qud·dîm ū·ṭə·lu·’îm
verses.literal: they mated in front of the branches And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted
verses.literalPt: E concebiam os rebanhos diante das varas, e as ovelhas davam crias listradas, salpicadas e malhadas.

verses.original: וְהַכְּשָׂבִים֮ הִפְרִ֣יד יַעֲקֹב֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן פְּנֵ֨י הַצֹּ֧אן אֶל־ עָקֹ֛ד וְכָל־ ח֖וּם בְּצֹ֣אן לָבָ֑ן וַיָּֽשֶׁת־ ל֤וֹ עֲדָרִים֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שָׁתָ֖ם עַל־ צֹ֥אן לָבָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kə·śā·ḇîm hip̄·rîḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yit·tên pə·nê haṣ·ṣōn ’el- ‘ā·qōḏ wə·ḵāl ḥūm bə·ṣōn lā·ḇān way·yā·šeṯ- lōw ‘ă·ḏā·rîm lə·ḇad·dōw wə·lō šā·ṯām ‘al- ṣōn lā·ḇān
verses.literal: Jacob set apart the young but made the rest face . . . the streaked dark-colored sheep in Laban’s flocks Then he set his own stock apart and did not put them with Laban’s animals
verses.literalPt: Então separou Jacó os cordeiros, e pôs as faces do rebanho para os listrados, e todo o moreno entre o rebanho de Labão; e pôs o seu rebanho à parte, e não o pôs com o rebanho de Labão.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּכָל־ יַחֵם֮ הַצֹּ֣אן הַמְקֻשָּׁרוֹת֒ וְשָׂ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֧ב אֶת־ הַמַּקְל֛וֹת לְעֵינֵ֥י הַצֹּ֖אן בָּרֳהָטִ֑ים לְיַחְמֵ֖נָּה בַּמַּקְלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·ḵāl ya·ḥêm haṣ·ṣōn ham·quš·šā·rō·wṯ wə·śām ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- ham·maq·lō·wṯ lə·‘ê·nê haṣ·ṣōn bā·ro·hā·ṭîm lə·yaḥ·mên·nāh bam·maq·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Whenever the stronger females of the flock were in heat Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in full view of the animals so that they would breed in front of the branches
verses.literalPt: E sucedia que cada vez que concebiam as ovelhas fortes, punha Jacó as varas nos canos, diante dos olhos do rebanho, para que concebessem diante das varas.

verses.original: וּבְהַעֲטִ֥יף הַצֹּ֖אן לֹ֣א יָשִׂ֑ים וְהָיָ֤ה הָעֲטֻפִים֙ לְלָבָ֔ן וְהַקְּשֻׁרִ֖ים לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ha·‘ă·ṭîp̄ haṣ·ṣōn lō yā·śîm wə·hā·yāh hā·‘ă·ṭu·p̄îm lə·lā·ḇān wə·haq·qə·šu·rîm lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: But if the animals were weak he did not set out the branches So the weaker animals went to Laban and the stronger ones to Jacob
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando era fraco o rebanho, não as punha. Assim as fracas eram de Labão, e as fortes de Jacó.

verses.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֥ץ הָאִ֖ישׁ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־ לוֹ֙ צֹ֣אן רַבּ֔וֹת וּשְׁפָחוֹת֙ וַעֲבָדִ֔ים וּגְמַלִּ֖ים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rōṣ hā·’îš mə·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ way·hî- lōw ṣōn rab·bō·wṯ ū·šə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm ū·ḡə·mal·lîm wa·ḥă·mō·rîm
verses.literal: Thus Jacob became exceedingly prosperous He owned large flocks maidservants and menservants and camels and donkeys
verses.literalPt: E cresceu o homem em grande maneira, e teve muitos rebanhos, e servas, e servos, e camelos e jumentos.
